dct_description_sm: The Alaska Department of Fish and Game (ADF&G) has been the lead agency for monitoring the biological status of the WAH since it was first identified as a discreet herd. The National Park Service (NPS), Bureau of Land Management (BLM) and Fish & Wildlife Service (FWS) support population monitoring efforts. Both the State of Alaska Board of Game and Federal Subsistence Board regulate hunting of this herd. The project consists of annual monitoring, calving success, calf survival, animal condition. Abundance monitoring every year or 2rd year.
dct_title_s: Western Arctic Caribou Herd Monitoring in the National Petroleum Reserve, Alaska
